subject: Myth & Symbolism
subcategory: The World Tree and Cosmic Maps
title: Islands Beyond the Horizon
description: One-minute skill: Islands Beyond the Horizon.

hook.text: Atlantis, Avalon, Hy-Brasil, Shambhala—mythic islands sit just beyond the horizon, always out of reach.

buildup.text: Plato described Atlantis as a powerful civilization swallowed by the sea. Explorers searched for it for centuries.

discovery.text: Avalon is where King Arthur was taken after his last battle. The healing island lies beyond mortal reach.

twist.text: These islands serve a psychological function: the belief that somewhere perfect exists just beyond what you can see.

climax.text: The invisible island is hope mapped as geography. It says: this world is flawed, but a better one is out there.

quiz.question: Where was King Arthur taken after his last battle?
